plugins.name: find-your-voice
plugins.description: Discover your real writing voice through impromptu writing exercises, then package it as a reusable 'write like me' skill.

plugins.name: process-eval
plugins.description: Evaluate any process against established, cited frameworks to find bottlenecks, steps to combine, and checklist candidates. Asks questions first, then reports.

plugins.name: capture-tribal-knowledge
plugins.description: Interview a subject-matter expert to extract tacit know-how, then write it up as a Confluence-ready runbook, a reusable Claude skill, or both.

plugins.name: high-output-management
plugins.description: Apply Andy Grove's High Output Management to your team: leverage, meetings and 1:1s, OKRs, indicators, task-relevant maturity, delegation, performance reviews.

plugins.name: radical-candor
plugins.description: Coach feedback with Kim Scott's Radical Candor: draft feedback and praise, prep hard conversations, diagnose your quadrant, build a candor culture.
